Aggregator.description: Event selection of a `run/0.1` SSA request.

Budget.description: Resource limits of a run request.

max_events_per_replicate.description: Required for SSA; omitted for FSP, which has max_states. A replicate that reaches the cap stops with `event_limit`.

max_output_bytes.description: Byte budget for the result, at least 8 × save_times × (1 + species × (statistics + kept trajectories)). For an archive it covers every archive file; execution never uses more than 256 MiB.

threads.description: Worker allowance, 1–1024. Execution uses at most 64 workers and no more than the replicate count; completed results do not depend on it.

wall_time_s.description: Optional wall-clock limit in seconds, finite and positive. It is polled cooperatively, so it is not a hard deadline; unfinished replicates stop with `wall_time_limit`.

Ensemble.description: Independent replicates of a stochastic run.

replicates.description: Number of independent replicates, ≥ 1, with ids 0 to replicates − 1.

root_seed.description: Root seed. Each replicate draws from its own stream, derived from this seed and the replicate id, so results do not depend on the thread count.

Method.description: Solver of a run request, selected by `kind`.

oneOf.description: `ssa`: exact Direct stochastic simulation of an ensemble. Needs `ensemble` and `budget.max_events_per_replicate`.
`fsp`: finite state projection of the probability distribution on a bounded box. Takes no ensemble, event cap or retained trajectories.

bounds.description: Inclusive upper count bound for every species, by name, each at least the initial count. Probability that leaves the box moves to an absorbing sink.

max_states.description: Most reachable states to enumerate, ≥ 1; execution also caps it at 100000.

tolerance.description: Total Poisson-series truncation budget over the whole run, 0 < tolerance < 1. It does not bound floating-point error.

ModelRef.description: Reference from a request to its model file: a relative path and the SHA-256 of the exact model bytes.

path.description: Portable, relative to the run file's directory; no parent traversal.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact model input bytes, lowercase hexadecimal.

Outputs.description: What a run reports besides the per-replicate accounting; at least one statistic or trajectory.

keep_trajectories.description: How many replicates, starting from id 0, return their saved states; at most `replicates`, and 0 for FSP.

statistics.description: Statistics to compute, each at most once. Stochastic methods report them only when every replicate completed.

RequestVersion.description: Schema tag of a tau-leaping request.

Run.description: A fixed-network execution request bound to one model file by relative path and SHA-256. `simulate`, `simulate-cached` and `fsp` read it, and tau requests embed it.

ensemble.description: Replicate count and root seed; required for `ssa` and absent for `fsp`.

RunVersion.description: Schema tag of a fixed-network run request.

Statistic.description: Ensemble statistic to report per species and save time.

TimeGrid.description: Time horizon and the times at which states are reported, in seconds.

end.description: Horizon in seconds, finite and positive.

save_times.description: Explicit sorted grid including 0 and end; no accumulated step rounding. 2–1000000 strictly increasing values. The state saved at a time includes every event at or before that time.

description: Experimental approximate Poisson-leaping request around an exact SSA reference run.

epsilon.description: Accuracy parameter in [0.001, 0.2] that bounds the expected relative change of species counts, and so of rates, within one leap. Smaller is more accurate and slower.

max_leaps_per_replicate.description: Most leaps and fallback steps per replicate, 1–10000000; exceeding it fails the replicate.
